maintainer: Pour les analogue c'est pire ! Tu as rogner sur les deux analogue et quand je les bouges ont remarque les défauts !!!
installed: IPA 657 (PR #160 GameCube Original 9988f5d7): the moving piece is PR #160's top-face circle
observed: device-0155-main-stick.png / device-0155-c-stick.png: the moving disc is smaller than the top drawn on the board; its side wall (8-9 board px below the face on the main stick, 6-7 px on the C-stick) and 2-3 px at the main stick's sides stay behind as a crescent, and the flat fill under the disc shows its own edge when the stick moves
cause: PR #160 measured the light face only (a circle). The piece that moves on a real stick is the face plus the side wall seen below it, down to the dark contact line: taller than wide, a stadium. A face circle crops it.
fix: each GameCube/Wii stick declares the measured stadium of its moving top (left, top, right, bottom on the board: board-moving-tops.png, stadium below); the knob is that stadium (+0.6 px edge, snapped to whole upscaled pixels so the knob and its frame share one centre); the frame is as much taller as the top is, so travel is equal in X and Y; the area under the top is a harmonic fill from the socket, skirt or yellow C base pixels all round (no disc edge, no streak), slightly darker toward the middle. The C-stick's yellow base stays. PS2 Original byte-identical.
reproducible: second build: the 3 archives and 6 previews byte-identical
audit: audit-before-after.json (before = PR #160 archives): misrouted 0 % after; knob centre 0.02-0.16 pt from the measured top (0.26-1.71 before); travel 7.7-11.0 pt (7.3-11.0 before)
